structural_candidate_definitions.reversal_sequence_trough: Minimum option premium low from the first opening-low-break candle through the candle immediately before the completed breakout entry candle; causal and available by entry.
structural_candidate_definitions.last_causal_swing_low: Most recent low after breakdown and before entry that is strictly below the lows of the preceding two completed bars; causal left=2/right=0 analogue; absent in 30 entries.
structural_candidate_definitions.breakdown_candle_low: Low of first opening-low-break candle; rejected as universal long stop anchor where it lies at/above entry.
structural_candidate_definitions.breakout_candle_low: Low of completed entry/breakout candle; measured as a comparison, not assumed structural anchor.

reversal_sequence_trough|buffer=0.expectancy_status: resolved-only premium-point mean; excludes unresolved/ambiguous and costs, not full-strategy expectancy
reversal_sequence_trough|buffer=0.touch_convention: inclusive: later bar low <= stop; later bar high >= target; entry bar excluded

target_timing_intervals.interval_definition: from completed entry candle close to first target-touch candle start/end; exact intrabar touch time is unavailable

limitations: Candidate lows are research hypotheses, not part of the unchanged canonical specification.
OHLC cannot resolve intrabar ordering; same-candle stop and target are labeled AMBIGUOUS. Stop/target fills at exact level are hypothetical, with no slippage, fees, position size or capital model.
No candidate buffer is selected by these descriptive comparisons; the buffer remains a controlled parameter.
A complete exact option contract session was available for every existing Ekalayava event; overall expected option universe remains incomplete and can suppress missing-contract setups.
Positions unresolved at the end of the observed session remain OPEN/UNRESOLVED; no EOD exit is invented.

primary_reversal_trough_simulation_recom.source: exact option CSVs for each existing Ekalayava event; no downloaded data

methodology_reconciliation: The primary reversal-trough lifecycle table was recomputed from the exact underlying option CSV rows and uses inclusive touch semantics (bar low <= stop).
All 253 event contract-day paths used for entry analysis contain a complete 75-candle session; these 253 rows are conditional on the contracts/events present in the corrected baseline.
Duplicate primary-anchor buffer 0/2/4 summary, monthly, and chronological tables were synchronized to the recomputed inclusive stop-touch replay; stale strict-touch counts were removed.
